items.quote: Instead of focusing on selling, shift your focus to what your clients really care about—results. Share Before & After Stories
items.statement: Shift your focus to what your clients really care about—results.

items.quote: Share behind-the-scenes moments or real stories, like “Here’s how I helped a first-time buyer feel confident, even though they were nervous.” When you show the real you, clients will trust you more.
items.statement: Share behind-the-scenes moments or real stories to show your authentic self.

overview: LinkedIn post about steps to build a personal brand and attract clients.
